title: Modern Dialog Engine & Expressive In-App Updates (v0.4.3)
message: Major UI & workflow upgrade: Google Code Scanner for classroom joining, offline teacher QR generation, hardware-accelerated frosted glass backdrop blur behind dialogs, unified modern dialogs across the app, and modernized GabAI APK updater.
changelog:
• Universal Modern Dialog Engine: Replaced system dialogs with GabAI Expressive Dialogs (28dp rounded surfaces, 3D icon badges, uppercase monospace letter-spaced inputs, and tactile spring feedback)
• Hardware-Accelerated Backdrop Blur: Real-time GPU window backdrop blur (FLAG_BLUR_BEHIND) behind every dialog on Android 12+
• Expressive In-App Update System: Modernized update interface with 28dp rounded card, rocket badge, live progress indicator, and streamlined GabAI-v0.4.3.apk asset delivery
• Google Code Scanner: Instant zero-permission camera QR code scanning powered by Google Play Services to join classroom sections in one tap
• Offline Teacher QR Codes: High-contrast classroom QR codes generated instantly on-device via ZXing for teachers in Profile and Section views
• Full App-Wide Dialog Modernization: Transformed PDF jump, document rename, folder creation, sign out, and deletion alerts to the modern design system
